Buddy up, brush together, build great habits

With Philips One For Kids by Sonicare, your little one can learn how to brush every part of their mouth for the recommended 2 minutes. The gentle pulse reminders and fun design help them to switch easily from manual to electric brushing.

First step to better brushing

Buddy up, brush together, build great habits

  • 2min SmarTimer

  • Soft bristles

  • Micro-vibrations

  • Colorful handle and stand

The first step to build healthy lifelong habits

The built-in timer helps your child to brush for the recommended 2 minutes. With the QuadPacer's gentle pause in vibration every 30 seconds, they'll feel when it's right to move to a different part of their mouth.

A dash of joy in your child's bathroom space

Fun and easy to use, Philips One For Kids has a colorful handle that's lightweight and easy to grip. The playful stand lets your child enjoy their own space in the bathroom from an early age.

Specially designed to protect kids' teeth and gums

Our brush head's soft mini-bristles help protect tooth enamel and gums and the rubber backing feels gentler for little mouths. Don't forget to change the brush head every 3 months for best results!

Mom-of-two

10/03/2026

US

Had it over 2 years. Cleans effectively.

My 3 year old now loves to brush her teeth. The vibration reminders let her know when it’s time to clean a new part of her mouth and when 2 minutes are up. The color way is so cute. We have been using it now for 2 years and love it so much we just purchased a new one for a one year old son. Even after two years of daily use, product works great! My only complaint is I can’t find the toothbrush heads in store or on Amazon so I have to buy them directly from Philips website. Definitely not something that was a make-it-or-break it for me but was worth mentioning.

Pros

Perfect size for small hands. Toothbrush heads perfect for bay teeth. Vibrations aren’t too strong that it bothers child while brushing. Cute color options. Reminders when to clean new quadrant of mouth and automatically turns off when 2 minutes are up.

Cons

Toothbrush heads have to be purchased directly on Philips website.

Yes, I recommend this product

Verified buyer

My 5 year old looks forward to brushing her teeth!

I love that this has a changeable brush head, easy to change battery, counts for 2 minutes, and has that great sonicare vibration which is smooth and efficient! A lot of the other over the counter electric toothbrush brands do not let you change the brush head or battery which is a total waste. My 5 year old actually looks forward to me brushing her teeth (Perks of having a dental hygienist as a mom) which was not always the case before! The colors are cute and the stand is adorable. I highly recommend as both a mom and a hygienist!

Pros

Changeable brush head, replaceable battery, 2 minute timer with 30 second intervals, sleek design

Cons

I wish there were more colors!

Yes, I recommend this product

Portlandmom

04/12/2023

US

Part of promotion

awesome for kids

This is a GREAT toothbrush for many reasons. It's small so fits nicely for a kids grip. There is a 30 second timer (toothbrush shakes a bit) that is intended to be used for the molars. The 2 minute timer focuses kids to actually brush their teeth for a longer duration. As a parent, I know it is nearly impossible to force a kid to brush their teeth for that long - even with one of those sand timers. The stand is compact so doesn't take a lot of counter space. Note that this is NOT a rechargeable battery so you will have to replace the AAA battery.

Yes, I recommend this product
